name: Tsuru (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Tsuru city emblem in white: an angular stylised character of diagonal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Tsuru, a city in Yamanashi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 5 August 1954.

features.role: Tsuru city emblem — an angular stylised character of diagonal strokes
